prompt_en.description: The main reverse-engineered generation prompt in English. One dense paragraph, comma-separated descriptors, ready to paste into any text-to-image tool.

prompt_zh.description: Chinese rendering of prompt_en, for the user to sanity-check accuracy.

subject.description: The main subject and what it is doing, in English.

style.description: Art style, genre, era, and any recognizable technique or movement, in English.

composition.description: Framing, camera angle, subject placement, depth layers, aspect feel, in English.

lighting.description: Light sources, direction, quality, time of day, mood of light, in English.

color.description: Palette, dominant hues, saturation, contrast, grading, in English.

medium.description: Physical or digital medium and texture: oil on canvas, 3D render, photograph, pixel art, etc., in English.

camera.description: Implied lens, focal length, aperture, film stock or render engine. Empty string if not applicable (e.g. flat illustration).

mj_params.description: Midjourney trailing parameters only, e.g. '--ar 3:2 --style raw --stylize 250'. Aspect ratio must match the actual image dimensions given in the metadata.

sd_positive.description: Stable Diffusion style positive prompt: comma-separated weighted tags rather than prose.

sd_negative.description: Stable Diffusion negative prompt appropriate for this image type.

tags.description: 5 to 12 short keyword tags summarizing the image, for search and filing.
